method: Independent web-reader inspection of primary publisher date, abstract and main aggregate description
evidence_type: Peer-reviewed human genetic association study, not an intervention trial
interpretation: The 36-gene total spans combined and disorder-specific analyses; it is not 36 independently proven causal mechanisms or treatment targets. Probands, trios and all sequenced people are different units. The September publication predates today's scan; publicity does not reset publication date. No personal genotype, individual prediction, treatment or patient biology follows.
limitations: This independent check covers the date and selected aggregate distinctions, not full variant-level quality control, all supplements, penetrance or independent replication. No participant or family data were retrieved or retained. Original summary only.
reviewer: Integrating research agent; documentation check, not clinical peer review
